context: An elderly couple discusses a recent family gathering
purpose: Teach: さておき/おもう/あがる/はずし/内心/さわやか/ネガティブ/交わし

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: この間の集まり、みんなさわやかな笑顔でよかったなあ。
lines.en: The other day's gathering, everyone had such refreshing smiles, it was wonderful.
lines.style: Warm reflective elderly male tone, slow nostalgic pacing throughout.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ほんとうにね。孫たちと久しぶりに言葉を交わして、心が温かくなったわ。
lines.en: Truly. Exchanging words with the grandchildren after so long warmed my heart.
lines.style: Gentle grandmotherly warmth, soft sighs, affectionate elderly female voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 健太が挨拶のとき緊張であがるもんだから、内心ハラハラしたよ。
lines.en: When Kenta got nervous and tensed up during his greeting, I was secretly anxious inside.
lines.style: Chuckling reminiscent tone, slight amusement, gravelly elderly male voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ふふ、でもあの子、最後はちゃんと笑わせてくれたじゃない。ネガティブに考えすぎよ、あなたは。
lines.en: Hehe, but that boy made everyone laugh in the end. You think too negatively, dear.
lines.style: Teasing affectionate laugh, light playful scolding, warm elderly female tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: それはさておき、由美が眼鏡をはずしたとき、若い頃の母さんにそっくりだとおもったよ。
lines.en: That aside, when Yumi took off her glasses, I thought she looked just like you when you were young.
lines.style: Tender heartfelt delivery, slowing on the compliment, soft elderly male voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あら、お上手ね。年を取ってもそんなこと言ってくれるなんて。
lines.en: Oh my, how charming. To say such things even at our age.
lines.style: Surprised pleased laugh, slightly bashful warm grandmotherly tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: また来年もみんなで集まれたらいいなあ、と心からおもうよ。
lines.en: I sincerely hope we can all gather again next year.
lines.style: Wistful warm closing tone, contemplative elderly male voice, gentle pace.
